content:
Maya (AE): Quick help pls — Prospect CrescentCare wants a POC next week. They want to start on Hosted API but may move to Dedicated/Private. They say they have a custom model 'arcadia-llama-70b-finetuned-v2' (fp16). Requirements: streaming + kv-cache, avg latency target p50 <200ms, ~500 reqs/min, avg 1.5k tokens, and full security questionnaire answered by EOD Fri. Any immediate blockers?

Raj (SE): Do we have that artifact in our catalog? Name doesn't match any verified entry. We'll need the HF/S3 artifact + model.config.json. Also: which attention kernel (FlashAttn v2/v3) and RMSNorm ops? Those determine hardware compatibility.

Oliver (Solutions Eng): We tested an arcadia fork internally last month — it used FlashAttn2 and a custom RMSNorm patch. Serving on Hosted should be fine but Dedicated cost looks high unless they accept quantized variant (q4_0 or q8_0). Ask them if per-token quality drop acceptable.

Emily (SalesOps): Pricing ask — they want a ballpark for the POC (2 weeks of steady traffic, burst to 800 reqs/min). PricingBot, can you spit rough hosted vs dedicated delta for 70B non-quant vs q4_0?

PricingBot: Hosted estimate (non-quant fp16): ~ $X/day token-cost ~ high; q4_0 reduces per-token by ~3x. Dedicated reserved estimate (2-week trial w/ burst): invoiceable minimum + GPU-hours. I'll DM exact calc to Emily. :money_with_wings:

Lina (Product): Two product notes: 1) Streaming + function-calling: ensure model tokenizer matches our client adapter. Tokenizer mismatch kills streaming chunks. 2) KV-cache correctness: if they use custom attention mask modifications the cache can break; need a small synthetic smoke test that exercises multistep chat.

Zoe (Security): We can prefill the standard questionnaire. I need answers for: customer-managed KMS? (AWS/GCP/HSM), data residency (EU/US), retention policy for PII, and whether they require SOC2+HIPAA. If they want Private deployment we can support on-prem but timeline is longer.

Maya (AE): Good — I'll ask CrescentCare for: HF/S3 link to model, model config + RNG seed details, a small prompt set for eval (5 multi-turn flows), KMS preference, and their traffic profile (peak/minutes). Also confirm whether they accept q4_0.

Raj (SE): For onboarding steps from eng side: 1) run model compatibility scan (tokenizer, custom ops) 2) build a quantized candidate (q4_0) and run self-bleed/regression eval 3) run smoke load test with KV cache for 5k tokens history 4) enable streaming + function-call demo. Timeline: if artifacts arrive today, we can spin a smoke instance in ~48h.

Oliver (Solutions Eng): Add a test harness snippet they can run locally to validate tokenization/outputs before handing to us. Example curl we recommend they run against their image: 

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"arcadia-llama-70b-finetuned-v2","input":"<EOD> Hello\nHow are you?\nDraft a 3-line summary of the chat."}'
```

Oliver (Solutions Eng): If we see tokenization drift, ask them to provide tokenizer files or we can use a custom tokenizer adapter.

Zoe (Security): Note: for KMS customer-managed keys on Hosted we support AWS KMS via envelope encryption today; GCP KMS + HSM add-ons need an extra kickoff. If they require attestation/HSM we should flag Private early.

Maya (AE): I'll collect artifacts now. Target: get model + answers by EOD today so eng can start. CrescentCare also asked about contractual SLA for latency — can someone share the standard POC SLA paragraph?

Emily (SalesOps): Sharing typical POC SLA blurb in thread (minimal): 
"POC trials are best-effort; we provide operational support and monitoring. Enterprise SLAs apply to Dedicated/Private contracts only; Hosted free trials do not include latency/uptime guarantees."

Raj (SE): For the latency ask (p50<200ms) with 1.5k tokens avg on 70B — that's aggressive on Hosted. With q4_0 on A100-class or our Dedicated T4s with batching tuned we can maybe hit ~200-300ms p50; to reliably hit <200 you need higher-end GPUs or shorter context. Set expectation now. :warning:

Maya (AE): Noted — I'll align expectations. Last Q: they attached a security questionnaire PDF with some redlines. Zoe, can you triage and call out anything blocking for Hosted vs Private?

Zoe (Security): I'll triage now. Quick flag: they request customer audit logs for model weights access and privileged user MFA logs — we can supply access logs and IAM audit trails for Dedicated/Private; Hosted will have standard audit logs but not customer-managed HSM attestations. I'll mark those as potential blockers.

deploy-bot: deployment queued: spin-up-smoke-instance arcadia-70b-candidate (ephemeral) — ETA 45m

Oliver (Solutions Eng): I'll run the compatibility scan once the instance is up. Maya, leave the eval prompts in this thread and I'll kick off evals.

Maya (AE): Thanks all — I'll ping CrescentCare for artifacts and update here. If we get model link by 4pm we'll proceed with the 48h smoke. :thumbsup:
